notes.title: V.1.0.1751 Update
notes.notes:
Improved game experience

Modified enemy resistance capability: changed from blocking 100% damage to blocking 90% damage.

notes.title: V.1.0.1742 Update
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed issues that could cause crashes when changing equipment.
Fixed other minor issues.

notes.title: V.1.0.1734 Update
notes.notes:
New Feature

Added Monster Mode in combat. Now you can view enemy’s attack debuffs, resistances, and weaknesses in Monster Mode. Use this information to devise clearer battle strategies and achieve victory.

notes.title: V.1.0.1712 Update
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed some crashing issues and some minor bugs.

notes.title: V.1.0.1702 Update
notes.notes:
Improvement of Gameplay Experience

Reduced the number or damage values of attack debuffs for some monsters.

Fixes

Fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: V.1.0.1685 Update
notes.notes:
Improvement of Gameplay Experience

Reduced the number or damage values of attack debuffs for some monsters.


Fixes

Fixed an issue where the red flashing effect on character portraits was displayed at incorrect times during combat.
Fixed an issue where character positioning could become disordered during battle.

notes.title: V.1.0.1670 Update
notes.notes:
Enhance Gameplay Experiences

Reduced HP for regular monsters.
Debuffs applied to skill emblems by enemy attacks are nullified, except for Skill-Removal.
Adjusted the battle operation prompt interface to clearly display option features. (Options include retreat and other functions.)

notes.title: Update V.1.0.1655
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed a crash issue that could occur during battles

notes.title: Update V.1.0.1646
notes.notes:
Fixes:

Fixed an issue where characters could not be moved properly using the keyboard in the Tavern.
Fixed the problem where the board did not appear during battle.
Fixed the issue where V-Sync was not initializing correctly.

notes.title: Update V.1.0.1620
notes.notes:
New Features

 Option to disable camera shake effect during battles


Fixes

 Added missing German/French text
 Fixed widescreen display issues
 Minor attribute adjustments

notes.title: Hero Emblems II Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes:
Check out the latest trailer first!
[previewyoutube=bgWR-I3czPE;full][/previewyoutube]
We are thrilled to announce that the PC version of Hero Emblems II will officially launch on Steam on August 6th!

Get ready for an exciting match-3 RPG adventure! Whether you’ve played the iOS version or are new to the game, join us and enjoy the fun and challenges!

Thank you to all the players who gave feedback and suggestions. Your input helped us improve the game for a better experience at launch. 

Don’t forget to add Hero Emblems II to your Steam wishlist and share this great news with your friends! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2417940/

Thanks for your support and please stay tuned!
Let’s look forward to the release on August 6th together!🚀🌟
